title: deforceUtils
description: A utility mod that provides user useful mechanics like noclip, reach and other in singleplayer/server with plugin
body:
![Title](https://capsule-render.vercel.app/api?type=transparent&height=50&color=gradient&fontSize=50&text=deforceUtils&stroke=000&strokeWidth=2) now with actual 26.x support! ![Stable](https://img.shields.io/badge/main-26.2-5a5?style=flat) ![MC](https://img.shields.io/badge/minecraft-26.X-55a?style=flat) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-ARR-red.svg?style=flat) ![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/deforcy/deforceUtils) ![Maintenance](https://img.shields.io/badge/Maintained%3F-yes-green.svg) ![Alert](https://capsule-render.vercel.app/api?type=transparent&height=40&color=gradient&text=PLUGIN%20IS%20A%20SEPARATE%20FILE%20REQUIRED%20ON%20SERVER&stroke=000&strokeWidth=2&fontSize=32&fontColor=f00&animation=twinkling) You can find it by going to versions tab:

Custom builds/previews available for [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/deforce) supporters!
This is a client mod + server plugin combo of deforceUtils (my utils) that adds various helpful stuff, like: - Noclip ![noclip icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3da2bae69a04e0cff48bf8ec9a1df91208160e24.png) - Infinite reach ![infinite reach icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9c42036d124001fdaaebbba93275fc07fc97d43.png) - No block placement restrictions ![no block placement restriction icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8bb1c68f02d49ad9076a2310c85c08a2cc36b0ea.png) - No block placement update ![no block update icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f27775c5ff64601ba5e3a9f458ab728192db104.png) - And lots of other stuff already added!

These features were heavily inspired by `Axiom mod` features, but implemented for 26+ versions of Minecraft and for Spigot/Paper/Purpur/Folia/Folia-fork server environments. Planned new features for newer versions: - Render entities through blocks (**Done!**) - Easy-to-use entity attribute editor - Easy-to-use /give, /summon command generators - Client side console (**Done!**) - Shader editor in real time (**Done!**) - Entity data visualizer (**Done!**) - And so on! If you've found an issue, or got an idea, you can always report it [here](https://github.com/deforcy/deforceUtils) _Currently close-source, but thinking about changing that in the future_ ![Player standing inside the sand block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b74041c4a3df8f49d80344a134586de0cd7d94b.jpeg)
